data.status: expected to open in early December
data.short_description: Communal Coffee is bringing its craft coffee, food, flowers and retail concept to Solana Beach in a mixed-use development along Pacific Coast Highway. Owner Jen Byard secured the space in mid-September, and the opening depends on permitting and construction timelines.
Byard confirmed Communal Coffee is also preparing to open a location in the UTC area. June or July 2027 is the current target.

data.location: Camarillo Premium Outlets, 740 Ventura Blvd., Camarillo
data.short_description: The Taco Shop Mexican Kitchen is opening in the Promenade section of Camarillo Premium Outlets, between Luru's Cafe and Rip Curl, in a space previously occupied by Panera Bread. The restaurant first opened in Oxnard in 2017 and serves Puebla- and Veracruz-inspired cooking.

data.store_name: Good Neighbor Cà Phê (rebranding as Portland Cà Phê)
data.event_date: Over the next couple of weeks
data.short_description: Good Neighbor Cà Phê, a Vietnamese-inspired coffee shop that opened in August 2025, is rebranding as Portland Cà Phê. Owner Kim Dam announced the change on social media. Changes to the menu or the cafe's look have not been announced.

data.status: would like to open in November, though the date depends on permits that are still pending
data.short_description: Louie, a new cocktail bar from owner Jesse Morrow, is taking over the former Garrison space in St. Johns. It will hold roughly 30 guests and have a patio with picnic tables and a fire pit, with a menu focused on classic cocktails.
The Garrison was a popular neighborhood bar that closed around March 2026. Its space is being taken over by Louie.

data.store_name: Matcha Cafe Maiko (rebranding as Matcha Toko)
data.short_description: Matcha Cafe Maiko in Sacramento's Little Saigon district has temporarily closed while the chain rebrands as Matcha Toko. All company locations closed on Nov. 8, and no reopening date has been announced.

data.location: 721 Eighth Ave., East Village, San Diego
data.short_description: Chefs Neale Holaday and Ross Garcia plan to open Prauper House, an all-day eatery and natural wine bar. It will occupy the ground-floor space beneath The Artifact Inn, formerly home to The Farmacy, and sourdough will be central to the menu.

data.event_date: By the end of the year
data.short_description: Pablo's Mexican Restaurant is expanding to downtown Lansing as its third location, after Old Town and the Eastside. Owner Pablo Maldonado said there is no opening date yet, but it will reportedly open by the end of the year.

data.location: 3044 W Belmont Ave Floor 1, Chicago, IL 60618
data.short_description: A liquor license application was submitted for The Chicago Inn, a tavern in Avondale. Owner Kristian Naoumov plans to serve handhelds such as Italian beef and Chicago tavern-style pizza.
N/A

data.location: 88 Ninth Avenue, Meatpacking District, Manhattan, New York City
data.short_description: Sparrow Italia, owned by Noble 33, is opening its third location worldwide after London and Miami. It will serve Italian-American dishes with live music nightly, in a 132-seat main dining room.

data.location: 41 Union Square West near 17th Street, New York City
data.short_description: Voodoo Doughnut is opening its first New York City location, serving more than 35 doughnut varieties. It will be open daily from 6 a.m. to 3 a.m. and will offer opening-day promotions and a donation to City Harvest.
The Melting Pot in Arlington is closing after 26 years, with its final service on November 21. No reason was given, and the Reston and Gaithersburg locations will remain open.

data.location: Pearl District, San Antonio (along the San Antonio River Walk)
data.short_description: Otto's Ice House, a Goode Company open-air beer garden and restaurant, is permanently closing after nearly two years. It opened on April 15, 2025, and no reason for the closure was shared.
Atlanta-based specialty matcha brand Shogun Matcha is opening its first permanent, brick-and-mortar location. The menu will include hand-whisked ceremonial matcha, hojicha lattes and seasonal drinks.
First & 10 Sports Bar will take over a space in a historic building and will feature 22 televisions. It is from Yafet Geday, who also operated Mela in Decatur.
The article lists Rock Dawg Tavern as an upcoming Metro Atlanta opening. Further details are cut off in the provided text.

Clutch City Cluckers, which serves halal Nashville-style hot chicken, is celebrating the grand opening of its FM 1960 location. Promotions include free sandwiches for the first 150 guests and 50% off the menu from November 21 to 23.

data.location: 3881 Lake Emma Road, Lake Mary, FL 32746
data.short_description: Frutta Bowls has opened a new location in Lake Mary, co-owned by Sasikanth Payyavulla and Lakshmi Sura. The brand operates more than 40 locations in 16 states and plans at least 35 new locations.
Hinoka Sushi in South Sacramento officially closed after its final day of service on November 15. No reason was given, but the team hinted at a "new chapter."

data.location: 7455 SW Bridgeport Road, Tigard, OR 97224 (Bridgeport Village)
data.short_description: Mendocino Farms plans its first Oregon restaurant at Bridgeport Village in Tigard, with hiring apparently already underway. Its reported hours will be 10:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.

data.status: had its final night of service
data.short_description: Centro Mexican Kitchen served Boulder for nearly 20 years and had its final night of service this weekend. Big Red F Restaurant Group is converting the space into a new concept.

Big Red F Restaurant Group is replacing Centro with Altura, a "Mountain Mexican" restaurant focused on seasonal and locally sourced ingredients. Renovations include new flooring, seating, lighting and a 16-foot folding glass wall.

Mendocino Farms has applied for a retail food license, listed as pending, for a DTC location at On The Square. The redevelopment by Shea Properties is replacing the former Marina Square shopping center.

Pronto Italian Sandwiches is preparing to open a new location at 3464 N. Clark St. in Wrigleyville, steps from the ballpark. It will be the brand's first official standalone storefront in Chicago. The concept centers on schiacciata bread made from scratch daily.
Pronto's Park Ridge location just opened this week. It joins locations in Hinsdale, Des Plaines, Naperville, Elmhurst, and an outpost at O'Hare.

data.location: 2014 Texas Heritage Parkway, Suite 230, Plaza at Jordan Ranch, Fulshear
data.short_description: Swirly, a frozen yogurt shop, is coming to the Plaza at Jordan Ranch in Fulshear. It will be Swirly's first location. Permitting has been completed and construction is underway.

Club Studio is preparing to open a new fitness club at 121 S. Westlake Boulevard in Thousand Oaks. The club will occupy a former Bed Bath & Beyond space at Northgate Plaza and is planned to operate 24 hours a day. It will extend the brand's presence into Ventura County.

Halo 13, a collectibles retailer, plans to open a new location at the Beverly Center in mid-December. The business also has stores in Northridge, Valencia, Palmdale and Burbank. The store will serve as a test of the Westside market.

Clive Coffee is moving its showroom to 935 NW Davis St. in the Pearl District. The new space is expected to offer a larger showroom and more on-site inventory storage. The retailer sells espresso machines, grinders and home coffee equipment.
Clive Coffee's current showroom at 801 SE Hawthorne Blvd. is temporarily closed during the move. The showroom is relocating to the Pearl District.

data.location: 5925 Birdcage Centre Ln, Citrus Heights, CA 95610
data.status: in the final stages of construction
data.short_description: Rose Nail Lounge, owned by Vinh Nguyen, is expected to open in the Marketplace at Birdcage shopping center. Construction delays pushed the opening back from the summer. The salon takes over the former Black Sails Coffee Lounge space.

data.location: 20535 Yorba Linda Blvd Suite A Yorba Linda, CA 92886
data.event_date: by the end of this year
data.short_description: Curl Fitness is preparing to revamp its Yorba Linda gym with updated equipment and a reorganized floor plan. The gym has closed its Kids Club and plans to eliminate its cycle class area. It's unclear if the facility will close during the transition.

Peachy Elopements, an elopement studio by Nina and Joe Woolford, is preparing to open in Rockton. It will offer curated wedding experiences starting at $199. Its website currently shows only a coming-soon message.

Portillo's is planning a new restaurant near Woodland Mall in Kentwood, next to REI. The Kentwood Planning Commission reviewed the landscape plan and building elevations this week. The site will have a drive-thru lane and 80 parking spaces.

data.status: on track to debut by March
data.short_description: Slipcast Brewing is taking shape in downtown Franklin with a taproom, full-service kitchen and outdoor patio. The taproom will seat approximately 180 guests indoors plus about 75 outdoors. Construction is progressing, with 25 of 44 milestones complete.

data.location: 282 Ridge Road, Lexington, NC, United States, 27295
data.short_description: Casolo's Pizza, owned by Joseph Casolo, is preparing to bring Manhattan-style pizza to Lexington. An inspector identified work needed before the building can be approved. The shop also plans to offer cannoli and jarred sauce.

data.location: 88 District Square SW Fl 3.1, Washington, DC 20024
data.short_description: Chef Jaspratap "Jassi" Bindra is opening Maati, a regional Indian cuisine concept. It takes over the 88 District Square space that previously housed NaRa-Ya. The restaurant will be on the second floor.

data.location: Independence Ave SW &, 7th St SW, Washington, DC 20560
data.short_description: Dolcezza plans a custom-designed container outpost in the Hirshhorn Museum's sculpture garden. It has operated in the museum lobby since 2018. The project is a collaboration with architect Hiroshi Sugimoto.

Nikki's Street Eatery from chef Nikki Hicks is heading to Koncept House Capitol View. It will be Hicks' first brick-and-mortar restaurant, serving soulful fusion street food. Hicks has been acquiring permits and equipment.

Artista, from John-Paul Gagliano, is under construction at the Memphis Art Museum. It will seat up to 99 guests and have its own entrance. Originally slated for January 2027, it is now on track for a February debut.
The team behind Kitchen Master is opening Wabi Sabi at Midtown Union. The brand has signed an 8,815-square-foot lease. It will include a dining room, lounge, bar and speakeasy with a mezzanine.

data.status: grand opening at some point next month
data.short_description: Wing Guru is opening a to-go-only location at 4980 Park Avenue. It takes over the space previously occupied by Rayford's Hot Wings. A certificate of occupancy application is under review.

data.location: 201 Arnold Rd, St Simons Island, GA 31522
data.status: renovations are expected to be completed in May
data.short_description: The King & Prince Resort and Club on St. Simons Island is undergoing a revamp, including the golf course and clubhouse. Designer Amanda Lindroth will update the interiors in the next phase.

data.location: 201 Arnold Rd, St Simons Island, GA 31522
data.short_description: The resort is partnering with chef Ford Fry to open four dining concepts. Fry leads Rocket Farm Restaurants.

Rock Dawg Tavern is taking over the Timbers space in Smyrna. Owner Terry Tucker previously owned Timbers and took it back over in early September. The tavern will feature 13 TVs and a private party space.
Dunkin' will open a new location in a newly built travel center in Hernando. Helen 28 LLC, which runs the travel center and Dunkin', is hiring staff. Planned hours are 5 a.m. to 8 p.m. daily.
